ideas.title: Unlock Commenting
ideas.reward: Post a comment without signing in

ideas.title: Sponsored Brand Topic
ideas.reward: Priority access to curated news topic

selected.why: High-intent reactive moment (m9). Provides a clear, non-intrusive alternative to a hard sign-up wall, improving conversion and engagement for non-logged-in users.
Creates a proactive habit loop (m6) where none exists. Gamifies news consumption, increasing retention and DAU without interrupting article reading.
Adds a premium tier (product change) that creates tangible value. Matches the 'Wait or Watch' pattern (TAX-3), allowing users who don't subscribe to still access high-value analytical content.

proposals.title: Unlock Commenting with Game Play
proposals.oneLiner: Allow non-signed-in users to post a single comment after playing a game.

newMechanic.name: One-Time Comment Post
newMechanic.description: Allows a guest user to bypass the mandatory sign-up wall to post exactly one comment by watching a rewarded ad. The app preserves the user's typed comment in local state during the ad flow and restores it upon REWARD_VERIFIED.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Comment sections thrive on volume; many users want to participate but churn at the sign-up gate.

proposals.trigger: User initiates a comment on s05 and triggers the sign-up wall. The app saves the current draft to local storage and restores it on REWARD_VERIFIED [ANTI-5].
proposals.eligibility: Non-signed-in users on the Add Comment Page (s05) who encounter the sign-up wall.

offer.title: Post This Comment
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with AOL News to post your comment without signing up.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: The offer is gated specifically to users who hit the sign-up wall. The primary 'Sign Up to Post' CTA remains the default. The reward is limited to a single post, ensuring users who want a long-term voice still have a clear incentive to sign up. Draft persistence ensures the comment text is preserved [ANTI-5].
risks: Users may find the ad wall frustrating compared to a seamless sign-up.
One-off comments may be lower quality than member comments.

proposals.title: Daily News Reader Streak
proposals.oneLiner: Turn daily news reading into rewards with a streak tracker and Reader Points redeemable for ad-free time and saved articles.

newMechanic.name: Reader Loyalty Program
newMechanic.description: Daily reading streak tracking and rewarded point collection backed by the signed-in AOL account cloud database for cross-session persistence.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: News apps lack inherent scarcity; this creates a habit loop for daily retention and unlocks rewarded ad inventory that complements organic reading while offering tangible utility like ad-free browsing hours.

proposals.trigger: Proactive entry via the daily streak badge on the News Feed Home screen.

offer.title: Earn Reader Points
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with AOL to earn 50 Reader Points. Redeem points for an ad-free browsing hour or extra saved article capacity.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: ReaderPoints are earned through attention and redeemed for utility like ad-free time or saved article capacity rather than direct cash, preserving IAP while leveraging cloud-synced account state.
risks: Users may ignore tasks if point redemption thresholds are set too high.
Cloud sync latency for streak persistence across devices.

proposals.title: Premium Insights Unlock
proposals.oneLiner: Unlock exclusive in-depth news analysis by playing a quick game.

newMechanic.name: Premium Insights
newMechanic.description: An additive tier of exclusive investigative deep-dive articles, marked with a distinctive 'Premium' badge. Access requires a new content-gating backend infrastructure that tracks individual 'PremiumAccess' entitlements per user.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: To establish a value-exchange for high-quality journalism, creating a premium ad-supported tier without removing any existing free content.

proposals.trigger: Returning user (session 2+) taps an article in the feed tagged as 'Premium'.

offer.title: Unlock Premium Insight
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to access this in-depth investigative article.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: Access is rate-limited to 3 premium articles per day via ad-unlocking. All existing free articles remain completely unblocked and ad-accessible as they are today; premium content is strictly additive.

kpis.holdout: 10% user-level holdout for 4 weeks to monitor IAP conversion impact if subscriptions are introduced.

risks: Low ad fill rate in certain geographies.
Editorial dependency on producing high-value investigative content.
